summary: Iteration 84 backend+frontend verification. All 12 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_84.py pass: family_discount_rate for 1..5 travelers (0, .10, .10, .15, .15), /api/content/site returns family_discount_tiers=[{min:2,rate:.10},{min:4,rate:.15}] and family_discount_text mentioning both %10 and %15, all 4 /photo-guide/*.jpg assets return 200, /api/applications with 4 travelers computes family_discount_rate=0.15 and discount=15% of subtotal, /api/orders endpoint still present. Frontend: home page height 6739px (<7000) at 1920x900, landing-how-it-works removed, all remaining sections and links present (6 advantages cards, 5 compare rows, doc-cards, review-spotlight, bundle-strip, tracking). /gerekli-belgeler shows documents-photo-guide with 1 good + 3 bad images. /esim (4 plan cards) and /seyahat-sigortasi (6 plan cards) contain NO qty-plus / store-submit-button / store-checkout-panel; both expose plans-*-cta and plans-*-apply-button; clicking apply navigates to /basvuru. Legal pages (/hizmet-sozlesmesi, /iade-kosullari, /kvkk) have h1.left == body.left == 441px (0px offset, well within 5px tolerance). /basvuru FamilyDiscountMeter shows tier-2 + tier-4 markers with 1 traveler and 'Yolcu ekle ve indirimi aç' button; 2 travelers -> '%10 aktif' badge; 5 travelers -> '%15 aktif' badge and summary shows '%15 indirim uygulanıyor.'.

critical_code_review_comments: content.py FAMILY_DISCOUNT_TIERS ordering isn't enforced; family_discount_rate() uses max() over matching tiers which is correct even if tiers were reordered, so implementation is robust.
compute_pricing returns bundle_discount_title unconditionally; if that field is displayed elsewhere it might read as active even when bundle_discount==0. Minor UI concern only.
test_iteration_83.py still fails on the (pre-existing) apply_background_report() issue for white-bg reference photo; unrelated to iteration 84 changes.
seed_data_creation: 1 /api/applications row (TEST_iter84 Aile, 4 travelers), a few uploads (dummy 1x1 PNGs). No cleanup endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run test_iteration_84.py serially with -n 0 (xdist installed but not needed). QuoteRequest expects field name 'visa_type_ids' (list of ids), NOT 'items'. /api/orders is the store checkout endpoint (not /api/order). To reach 4+ traveler state on /basvuru use data-testid=application-type-group + data-testid=add-adult-traveler-button — the family-discount-add-traveler CTA only shows when there is exactly 1 traveler.
rca of the issue: No new bugs found in iter84 scope.
